description: Open an upload field in the chat where the user chooses an invoice PDF or XML file. The file goes straight from the field to this server's validation without passing through the model, so a PDF is checked as a whole, including its PDF/A-3 container, and the validation runs on the KoSIT validator. For clients that cannot pass a file as a tool argument. Opening the field is free, and a check counts against the user's quota only once they press the button. This tool needs no input and checks nothing by itself. B2B only.
name: open_invoice_check
title: Open invoice file check
